scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run start:prod --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
